description: This is a unit test class for the UserRestEndpoint, testing various REST API methods such as getUser, createNewUser, updateExistingUser, and deleteUser. It uses Mockito and PowerMock to mock dependencies and verify behaviors.

classes.name: UserRestEndpointUTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserRestEndpoint, testing REST methods with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: getUserWithUserIdShouldReturnTheUser
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a user by ID returns the correct UserResource with HTTP status OK.

methods.name: createUserShouldCreateUser
methods.description: Tests that creating a new user calls the userService.createUser method with the correct User object.

methods.name: testUpdateUser
methods.description: Tests that updating a user calls the userService.updateUser method with the correct User object.

methods.name: testDeleteUser
methods.description: Tests that deleting a user by ID invokes the deleteUser method in userService.
